title: Brand Comparisons and Treatment
summary: Reviews in this topic compare the G70 with other brands on customer treatment, comfort or service preference, and perceived material quality, with examples that are somewhat heterogeneous.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car or brand is preferred over imported alternatives for comfort or service and include a complaint that other luxury brands had not provided such poor treatment.

negative.summary: Negative feedback mentions dissatisfaction with problems already encountered, but the example does not specify the exact issue.
